<!-- PHI-DIRECT -->
```powershell
Write-Output '=== RUNTIME DISTRICT DEFAULTS 411 - THE STREAMING NAMES READ FROM THE CLASS DEFAULT OBJECT (No map holds a placed District-class actor: VEILDistrict holds 44 actors, OMNIWorld holds 241, VEILWorld holds 239, and all three hold zero District actors. The district therefore enters play from source at runtime, and the standing read says ADistrict streams sublevels by distance through StreamingLevelNames. This job resolves the District class from the asset registry and the source tree, prints the resolved class path, reads its class default object, and prints the StreamingLevelNames value whole with property errors verbatim. It then prints every WorldBuilder source line carrying District, Streaming, Level, or Spawn, and every GameMode SpawnActor line with file names and line numbers. The verdict names DISTRICT STREAMS with the level names, DISTRICT STREAMS NOTHING when the list is empty, or CLASS UNRESOLVED with the reason. No edits anywhere.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 10) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'PHI DISTRICT411 NAMED HOLD: EDITOR STILL STANDING AFTER THE 100 SECOND IN-JOB WAIT - no commandlet launched into the contention'; Write-Output 'JOB 411 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output 'PHI DISTRICT411 EDITOR STATE AT PROCEED: no editor standing - proceeding on the clear road'
$base = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI'
$uproj = "$base\VEIL.uproject"
$cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
Write-Output '--- SECTION 1: DISTRICT CLASS DEFAULTS ---'
$py = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$out = "$base\Saved\phi_district411.txt"
$py = $py.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$out'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_district411.py" -Value $py -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item $out -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_district411.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\district411.log"
if (Test-Path $out) { Get-Content $out | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DISTRICT411 OUTPUT FILE'; Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\district411.log" -Pattern 'Error|Traceback|Exception' | Select-Object -Last 8 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output; Write-Output 'JOB 411 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 2: WORLDBUILDER SOURCE LINES ---'
$builderFiles = Get-ChildItem "$base\Source" -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*WorldBuilder*' }
if (-not $builderFiles) { Write-Output 'NO WORLDBUILDER SOURCE FILE FOUND' }
foreach ($f in $builderFiles) {
  Write-Output ("SOURCE FILE: " + $f.FullName)
  Select-String -Path $f.FullName -Pattern 'District|Streaming|Level|Spawn' | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ($f.Name + ' ' + $_.LineNumber + ': ' + $_.Line.Trim()) }
}
Write-Output '--- SECTION 3: GAMEMODE SPAWN LINES ---'
$spawnPattern = -join ([char[]](83,112,97,119,110,65,99,116,111,114))
$modeFiles = Get-ChildItem "$base\Source" -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*GameMode*' }
if (-not $modeFiles) { Write-Output 'NO GAMEMODE SOURCE FILE FOUND' }
foreach ($f in $modeFiles) {
  Write-Output ("SOURCE FILE: " + $f.FullName)
  Select-String -Path $f.FullName -Pattern $spawnPattern | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ($f.Name + ' ' + $_.LineNumber + ': ' + $_.Line.Trim()) }
}
Write-Output 'JOB 411 DONE'
```
